description: Find and replace text in the document or in one frame: find, replace, mode literal or grep (default literal), scope document or frame (frame needs frame_id), include_master_pages, include_hidden_layers, include_locked_layers (all default false), case_sensitive and whole_word (default false). dry_run true only counts and lists up to 200 matches with frame_id, page_name and index – use it before any name replacement. GREP metacharacters: ~M column break, ~R frame break, ~P page break, ~S non-breaking space (a literal U+00A0 is not found in literal mode); a straight " in GREP matches every quote, including typographic ones. Returns replacements, matches_found, scope, mode and master_pages_included. Locked managed stories (editorial workflow, lock_state as in get_frame_text) are never changed: their matches are left out of replacements and matches_found (also in dry_run) and listed in skipped_locked[] {story_id, frame_id, lock_state, managed_file, matches}, with a warning; without include_locked_layers InDesign does not search them, and a warning says how many there are. changes.modified_frame_ids lists the frames with replacements. No undo.

case_sensitive.description: Literal mode: match case. Default false.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

dry_run.description: true: count and list matches, change nothing.

find.description: Text or GREP pattern to find.

include_hidden_layers.description: Also search hidden layers. Default false.

include_locked_layers.description: Also search locked layers and stories. Default false. Matches in locked managed stories are reported in skipped_locked, never replaced.

include_master_pages.description: Also search master pages. Default false.

replace.description: Replacement text; required unless dry_run is true. "" deletes the matches.

whole_word.description: Literal mode: whole words only. Default false.

name: find_replace
title: Find and replace text
